reason: Right lane (the pick grants a focus spell the app models, and grantsFocusViaEffectChoice in build.ts then suppresses the record's own focusPoolBonus so the point isn't double-counted). Corrected twice: (1) the option list now covers all 64 domains that core.json's own deity records reference — the proposal was missing delirium, void and wyrmkin; (2) the 22 domains whose initial spell isn't in the data now carry grant.focusPoolBonus 1 instead of no grant, because ANY option with focusSpells makes grantsFocusViaEffectChoice true and kills the record's focusPoolBonus for every pick — without this a player picking e.g. Darkness would lose the Focus Point the feat gives them today. All 42 spell ids match DOMAIN_SPELLS exactly and exist in public/core.json; 0 of 485 deities carry an alternate-domain field, so kind 'domains' really is unusable here.
quote: Select one domain from your deity's alternate domains.

effectChoices.prompt: Alternate domain — one of your deity's alternate domains (not one of its four main domains). You gain that domain's initial domain spell and its Focus Point
